note: Which link urls a person is shown on a node: a url as the server stores it, its surrounding whitespace already trimmed, and whether the web shows it. The web shows a node's link only when its url starts with http:, https: or mailto:, in any case (SAFE_URL in web/src/products/roadmap/graph/tree/NodeWorkspace.jsx); the backend's MCP doors refuse any other (shownLinkUrl in backend/products/roadmap/domain/Command). Both read every case.
